measure.mjs reports G3 as 2/7 within 2x, and the number is an artifact of how the two quantities are dated rather than a failure of the DO NOT TOUCH rule. linesTouched(k) is the diff between attempt k-1 and attempt k, but linesCited(k) is computed from attempt k's OWN findings. A final attempt that passes clean has no findings, so its cited count is 0, and any repair at all then fails a 'touched <= cited x 2' test against zero. Four of the five failures are exactly that: chapter 2 attempt 2 (touched 1, cited 0), chapter 3 attempt 3 (2, 0), chapter 6 attempt 2 (1, 0) and chapter 8 attempt 2 (1, 0). The comparison the rule actually intends is against the citations on the SHEET that produced the redraft, i.e. attempt k-1's findings. Measured that way this run is 7/7 within 2x: ch1 1 vs 1, ch2 1 vs 2, ch3a2 2 vs 4, ch3a3 2 vs 2, ch4 3 vs 5, ch6 1 vs 2, ch8 1 vs 1. The one genuine near-miss on the instrument's own terms is chapter 4 attempt 2, 3 touched against 1 cited at that iteration, which was four patches closing three cited findings across two separate dialogue lines. Recommend measure.mjs compare linesTouched(k) with linesCited(k-1).

THE PATCH_THEN_HALT PATH, EXECUTED FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THE PROJECT'S HISTORY. Three candidate replacements were on the table and arbitration admitted none. The outline critic's is the text the draft already carries, a no-op. The science critic's adds 22 words against 5 of headroom, 567 against a hard 550 at tolerance 0, which trades a characteristic at 10 for one at 0. The continuity critic's is byte-identical to the sentence science scored 5 at attempt 1, so it would give aggregate 5 against the 7 on the table, and redraft rule 4 keeps the best draft. No rescore was run because no text changed; a rescore of an unchanged draft would produce a number that looked like new evidence and was not. RUN HALTED under LOOP-003 section 7. The reason the chapter cannot pass is structural: outline beat 7 requires the voice tape to be the first confirmation and world.md's RECOVERED bullet admits only a field-team callsign and a beacon tag number. Two of the three model critics were asked directly and both answered that no wording satisfies both. Under the stress profile's 9-to-10-beat rule a missing beat costs 3, so outline floors at 7 and min can never reach 8.
